items.q: Sidney played trumpet, and we had another trumpet player -- I'm thinking real hard now -- named Clay, Shirley Clay.

ctx.x: Well, Sidney played trumpet, and we had another trumpet player -- I'm thinking real hard now -- named Clay, Shirley Clay. He was one of the few trumpet players in those days that could play a verse and play a lot of soul with that verse, you know. Don found this out, and this is the way he featured him.
